name: find-issues
description: Finds Linear issues by searching for words in them, across the workspace or within one team, up to 50 results. Each issue's id, identifier (like ENG-123), title, priority, url and last update, with its state, team and assignee. The identifier is what linear__get-issue, linear__update-issue and linear__comment-on-issue take.

term.description: The words to search Linear issues for.

first.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

teamId.description: Narrows the search to one team: a team's id from linear__list-teams.
